module_summary: Differential source-synchronous DDR output: an ssio_ddr_out child produces a forwarded clock and DDR data, which target-specific buffers or inverters drive as P/N pairs.

anchors.name: input_d1
anchors.why: First SDR data word, launched on one clock edge by the DDR output child.

anchors.name: input_d2
anchors.why: Second SDR data word, launched on the opposite clock edge by the DDR child.

anchors.name: output_q_p
anchors.why: Positive leg of differential DDR data output.

anchors.name: output_clk_p
anchors.why: Positive leg of forwarded source-synchronous clock output.

anchors.name: output_q
anchors.why: Single-ended DDR data from child, fed to differential output buffers.

anchors.name: output_clk
anchors.why: Single-ended forwarded clock from child ODDR, fed to differential clock buffer.

anchors.name: output_q_n
anchors.why: Negative leg of differential data, inverted copy of output_q.

anchors.name: output_clk_n
anchors.why: Negative leg of forwarded clock, inverted copy of output_clk.

groups.name: ddr_serializer
groups.description: ODDR child muxes two SDR words onto both clock edges and forwards the clock.

groups.name: diff_output_buffers
groups.description: OBUFDS/ALT_OUTBUF_DIFF or inverters converting clock and data to differential pairs.
